ns2:course.label: Audience Analysis
ns2:course.description: Analyzes audiences and matches consumer insights with strategic ideas for brand communication, contact, and connection. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ADV 250 or ADV 283 and ADV 284. Restricted to students with Senior OR Graduate class standing.
